summary: Reproduced the MXFP4 Triton post-load state_dict omission on the prepared base and applied the existing upstream PR #34558 candidate. The registered Parameters now share the postprocessed runtime storage, sharded-state saving snapshots non-contiguous tensors contiguously on CPU, and CPU offload skips Parameters retained by external Triton wrappers.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on the recorded base: after real Mxfp4MoEMethod.create_weights and process_weights_after_loading with only layout conversion mocked, w13_weight was absent from state_dict; the independent offload guard also failed. Raw log: reports/j-16df850cda49/raw/failing_before_issue_specific.log

Passing-after two-case regression: packed weights and scales survive a safetensors sharded-state round trip into zero-initialized runtime wrapper storage, and wrapper-backed Parameters are excluded from CPU offload. Raw log: reports/j-16df850cda49/raw/passing_after_unit.log

On the assigned MI355X (gfx950), all four non-contiguous CUDA runtime tensors remained registered, were serialized to safetensors, loaded into a fresh layer, and retained pointer identity with the tensors consumed by wrapper objects. Raw log: reports/j-16df850cda49/raw/gfx950_storage_roundtrip.log
Regression syntax and patch whitespace integrity.
Formatting tool availability; the prepared interpreter does not contain the black module. Raw log: reports/j-16df850cda49/raw/black_check.log
Lint tool availability; the prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module. Raw log: reports/j-16df850cda49/raw/ruff_check.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The storage/save/load boundary test executed tensors on the single assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, reported gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and passed. This did not execute NVIDIA triton_kernels MXFP4 kernels.

remaining_limitations: The openai/gpt-oss-20b weights were not available, so the original 13G-versus-4G full-checkpoint export and a save/reload logits comparison were not run.

The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950, while the reported triton_kernels path and original GH200 reproduction are NVIDIA-specific. The layout conversion was deterministically mocked; GPU validation covered storage aliasing and safetensors transport, not NVIDIA kernel execution.
TP=2 and multi-node behavior were not exercised; no claim is made beyond the focused single-GPU fixture.
The prepared interpreter lacks Black and Ruff, so those checks could not run.
